verdict.rationale: Svelte's tooling is CLI-based (npx sv create/check/add, npm run build) and runs in Node without a browser, which is inherently CI-compatible, but there is no explicit documentation of CI pipeline integration, headless test running, or automation workflows, and community feedback flags weak documentation around testing setups. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), headless test runner guidance, and first-party automation docs beyond generic build/check commands.
